notes.title: Ironseed 2 Teaser
notes.content: [p]Work is coming along nicely on the new Ironseed sequel - "Ironseed 2 : Consensus"!  Here's a teaser of the main menu.  Give me another week or two to get a trailer out and set up the Steam Store  page.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38680242/d527837ae00f77578231d74dcd867822a2e3f79d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Story So Far…[/b][/p][p]It’s the 38th century. Earth is legend, long lost to time. Humanity now clings to survival on terraformed Mars — a world ruled by the Pentateuch, five cyber-priests who crushed dissent and built a brutal technocracy.[/p][p]But rebellion sparked in the shadows.[/p][p]The [i]Ironseed Movement[/i], a group of exiles, created a virus to dismantle the planetary AI systems and escaped aboard a stolen prototype starship. Their plan: vanish into deep space and wait for the technocracy to collapse. They were never heard from again.[/p][p][b]Now, the story continues…[/b][/p][p]You awaken alone, drifting in a crippled ship. The systems are offline. Weapons: gone. Memory: fragmented. The crew? Scattered — you are jettisoned into deep space under unknown circumstances.[/p][p]This wasn’t the original ship. It’s a backup, a failsafe — secretly loaded with your crew’s preserved minds in illegal containment vessels, and launched in parallel. A second chance... but barely.[/p][p]You are the captain. Your first task: [b]recover your crew[/b].[/p][p]Only together can you rebuild the ship, uncover the truth, and determine what comes next. There’s no clear destination. No home to return to. Just a fragile hope that somewhere out there, life can begin again.[/p][p][b]Ironseed: Consensus[/b] is a sci-fi RPG of survival, exploration, and rebuilding in the aftermath of escape. Travel procedurally generated star systems, retrieve your lost crew, and forge a new path forward — through debate, disagreement, and ultimately, consensus.[/p][p][b]Survival is only the beginning.[/b][/p]

notes.title: A retro goodie rebuilt from 1994, Ironseed 25th Anniversary Edition recently added Linux support
notes.content:
Ironseed from 1994 is not one I'm familiar with, I only know if I had seen it when I was small I probably would have played it for hours. Ironseed 25th Anniversary Edition is a modern 2020 remake and now it has a Native Linux version.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/a-retro-goodie-rebuilt-from-1994-ironseed-25th-anniversary-edition-recently-added-linux-support/

* Rebuilt application using Unity 6
* Added linux build
* Fixed auroras rendering in wrong layer sometimes
* Fixed Next/Previous buttons in local system display
* Fixed lights in main scene and local system interfering with each other 
* Fix selection box texture alpha channel

notes.title: Ironseed Update
notes.content:
1.1.8
=====
* Tweaks to bot production rates
* Conversation keyword drop list on Easy difficulty

Highly recommended to go to the Medical cubeface and Options and turn on Easy difficulty.  This will display a droplist of possible keywords.  Knowing all keywords is a bit of a spoiler but the greater concern is new players missing the story not knowing what to ask about.  If you just care about the story, Easy mode is the way to go.  Keywords will be adjusted based on various events.
